method: Read-only mechanical/documentary comparison of the specified decisions, their final page TeX, A/B/C report.json and reading.tex, records/reader_runs.json, briefs/history.json, progress.log, brief headings through v10, and scripts/validate.py. checks_without_fault: Every substantive difference identified between final A/B/C readings is represented by a three-reader comparison in the relevant decision. Shared readings are not required to carry redundant A/B/C maps.
All explicit image-path references checked in the scoped decisions and reader reports exist. Every changed-witness entry has a nonempty crop list. Image contents were not inspected or validated.

No unresolved-table reading contradicts the final page after allowing for shortened descriptions, macro grouping, first-occurrence reservations, and the separately positioned point over the cancelled article on scan010.
No notation entry was found to contradict a final in-place reading or uncertainty choice.
All inventoried elements are represented in the final text, macro structure, or explicitly permitted archive-number comments, apart from the stale uncertainty description identified as AUD-S002-001.
Check-event types belong to the allowed validator set and every outcome is a string. No type/outcome schema defect found.

All 33 reader-run starts and ends match their report timestamps. Starts precede ends, all returns precede each page-completion time, and each page’s readers start after the preceding audited page was completed.
Decision and reader-run brief filenames match the version sequence in briefs/history.json.
Scoped final-page TeX passes the existing validator’s brace, dollar, display/inline delimiter, and environment checks. Full validator main() was not invoked because it writes records/validation.json.
